items.summary: Union Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW), Sarbananda Sonowal, in Busan, South Korea, used a high-level ministerial roundtable on World Maritime Day and talks with South Korea's marine equipment industry to press one case: India wants maritime rules that every country can put into practice, and partners willing to build and grow with India.
items.title: Sarbananda Sonowal Woos Korean Firms for India's Shipyards, Seeks Global Shipping Rules All Can Follow

items.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has today released Recommendations on ‘Authorisation Framework for Application-based Linear Television Distribution (ALTD) Services’.
items.title: TRAI releases Recommendations on ‘Authorisation Framework for Application-based Linear Television Distribution (ALTD) Services’
